verdict.rationale: Antigravity is documented as an autonomous coding agent that edits code and runs terminal commands across editor, terminal, and browser, and it can delegate running tests to subagents. That makes these chores plausible, but none of the four named tasks is explicitly documented as a capability; test running is the closest match. Missing for 10: explicit test-writing support, lint-error fixing, merge-conflict resolution, dependency-update workflows, and independent hands-on corroboration of any of these.
